title: Feedback
author: Kind-Economist1075
selftext:
I need a quick playable demo and need some feedback.

Https://play.epm-gaming.co.uk

Made this in 2 nights after work. Early days but was wondering if its actually worth continuing.

The idea was from a starcraft 2 mod where you had to clear out the map of the zerg during the day and defend at night.

Only one playable nation at the moment with more to come

comments.author: That1guy4226
comments.body: so that was fun. Some sort of a guide or a tutorial would really be helpful. the music was rather nice and chill. As far as i could tell you can only get a buildings info by holding your cursor over it and it was partly obscured. A clear info box somewhere when something is selected might help with out causing to much clutter. I took a few mins to just explore the map and was impressed with the amount of available. over all solid work.

replies.author: Kind-Economist1075
replies.body: Thanks for giving it try. Ill try and sort out the info with unit stats showing. Ive been working on getting the custom backend working better. We can currently handle 300k units on the map and still have 4% head room. Animations could still use some work and the map gen is being a massive pain. The map gen could also use some refinement too with the mountains not being ass 😆

comments.author: Bratchan
comments.body: tutorial i have no clue what is going on. no clue how to do things..  characters are huge compared to the buildings. as well

replies.author: Kind-Economist1075
replies.body: Fair, i'll add in a tutorial and scale down the character sizes compared to the buildings
